_comment: The situation bank. One bad line here is a few hundred bad rows, and it is also one line that can be read, which is the whole reason it is a file rather than a generator. A situation says who is asking and what they are in the middle of; it never says anything about chemistry, because anything it said would be a claim nothing computed. Read end to end before a build.
